title: Pablo Silver Nicotine Pouches - Grape Ice - 10mg
description: Pablo Silver Grape Nicotine Pouches deliver a deep and juicy fruit profile designed for consistent, everyday use. As part of the highly anticipated Silver Edition range, this option provides a balanced 10mg nicotine strength. It offers a smoother experience compared to the brand’s traditional high-strength products, while still retaining the fast-acting release that Pablo is known for. The Grape flavour provides a substantial, sweet fruit experience that captures the distinct notes of dark, ripe grapes with an icy finish. It offers a robust and full-bodied taste, ensuring a thoroughly satisfying flavour from start to finish. Crafted for maximum convenience, the slim, all-white pouches fit discreetly under the upper lip. They provide a steady, reliable nicotine release entirely free of tobacco, smoke, or vapour, making them a highly practical choice for use at any time of day. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
